mic_question.title: Can you use a microphone?
mic_question.description: The one in your phone or laptop is enough.

first_riff_intro.phone_panel: On a phone, it's in the panel you open from the bottom bar.

beginner.title: Play with the click
beginner.body: The metronome keeps the beat. Hit the string when the cursor reaches the note. Too fast? Slow it down here.

beginner.title: The mic listens
beginner.body: Every note you hit lights up. You can turn it off here.

player.title: Every note is scored
player.body: Hits, timing and accuracy from the mic. Turn it off here.

beginner.title: Just play along
beginner.body: No mic, no scoring. Play with the tab, your time still counts.

player.title: Just play along
player.body: No mic, no scoring. Play with the tab, your time still counts.

beginner.title: Read the tab your way
beginner.body: Lines are strings, numbers are frets, 0 is an open string. Make it bigger here.

player.title: Set up the tab
player.body: Zoom and look, right under the tab.

tour.skipped_toast: Tour skipped. It's in the menu whenever you want it: {{take}}.

welcome.title: Hi, I'm Kostek
welcome.text: Let me show you around in about a minute: where things are and how to start. You can skip the tour at any time.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.text: The menu is always on the left. Every part of the app is one click away from here.
nav.text_mobile: The menu is always at the bottom. {{more}} holds the rest: notifications, community, the Arsenal and settings.

community.title: Notifications and community
community.text: The bell collects likes, replies and rewards. The icon next to it opens the community panel: what other players are practising, the chat and your guild.

stats.title: Streak, points and Fame
stats.text: The flame is your streak: days in a row with practice. From day 5 it adds 50% to your points. Points record your work and raise your level. Fame is the currency you spend in the Arsenal on guitars and pedals.
stats.text_mobile: This is your level. Every session pays points that raise it, and a streak of days in a row adds up to 50% on top. Sessions pay Fame too, the currency for guitars and pedals in the Arsenal.

quests.title: Daily quests
quests.text: Three small tasks wait here every day, and most of them get done just by playing. Finish all three and collect Fame and points.

week.title: Your week
week.text: Which days you played this week and for how long. Every session counts, even ten minutes.

feed.title: What others are playing
feed.text: Further down is what other players are practising right now. Motivate someone's session and they get Fame from you. It's a small thing that keeps people going.

go_practice.title: Where it all starts
go_practice.text: Everything in your log starts with playing. Press {{practice}} and I'll show you the ways to practise.

hub.title: Five ways into a session
hub.text: {{today}} is a plan you play through in one sitting. {{courses}} run for weeks. {{music}} is songs, {{technique}} is single exercises, and {{versus}} is duels and boss fights. Every one of them pays points and Fame and keeps your streak going.

log.title: Playing without the app?
log.text: Time you play elsewhere counts too. Run the stopwatch while you play, or log it by hand up to 7 days back.

start.title: Your start: {{name}}
start.journey: A course from the very basics, one lesson at a time. Come back here whenever you want your next step.
start.plans: A ready-made session with a timer that tells you what to play and for how long.
start.songs: Save the songs you want to learn and track how far you've got with each one.
start.roadmap: Weeks of steps toward one goal, like playing in the style of your hero.
start.log: Run the stopwatch while you play and the time lands in your log.
start.no_guitar: {{name}} is played on a guitar, so keep it for when you have one at hand. Today you can start with exercises that need no guitar: theory and ear training pay the same points and keep your streak too.

done.title: That's it
done.text: You can take this tour again any time from the menu: {{take}}. See you after your first session!
